_comment: Delta reuse allowlist (issue #2203): jobs of ci.yml a tier=main dispatch with delta=true may skip when the newest same-tree pull_request run has them green. Never-listed: aggregators (test-selection-verdict, test-duplicates, every cancel-after-*), the reuse job itself, selectors (changes/test-selection/package-selection/package-version-bump) and the runtime package jobs and sdk. Jobs that need a reusable job but cannot run on tier=main are in not_dispatch_consumers with the reason; the guard derives it from the workflow. The closure drops every producer whose consumer is outside skip. Pairs: platform-contracts and hermes-compatibility-macos are reused only together, in either direction (the lane's SKIP_OWNED_BY repeats that job's condition).

not_dispatch_consumers.test-selection-check: pull_request-only: its job-level if: requires github.event_name == 'pull_request' (the workflow itself restricts it; the guard derives the restriction from the workflow)
not_dispatch_consumers.test-selection-audit: nightly-only: its job-level if: requires schedule or (workflow_dispatch with tier == 'nightly') (the workflow itself restricts it; the guard derives the restriction from the workflow)

build-bins.reason: default-feature build of the shipped binaries; never reused because sdk always runs and downloads this run's archive (hermes-package, the other downloaders excluded from the allowlist, read the release baseline digest from pull_request-only package-selection)

build-tests.reason: compiles the workspace test archive from the lockfile; identical on the same tree

darwin-check.reason: aarch64-apple-darwin clippy of the same tree

names: docs check (schema + drift + source-map + runbooks + secrets + release)
docs.reason: docs check of the same tree

doctests.reason: documentation tests of the same tree

fast-tests.reason: full-selection legs run every test of the shard; a narrowed source never reuses them

feature-matrix.reason: feature powerset of the same tree

hermes-compatibility-macos.reason: Hermes macOS job on the same tree; reused only with its daemon producer

integration.reason: heavy suite runs from the archive with the full selection only

macos-package.reason: macOS package acceptance; its nightly-only cold-rebuild step runs on neither path

macos-release-build.reason: release daemon build; the closure keeps it when its consumers run

macos-tier.reason: tier archive built from the lockfile; no same-run artifacts

platform-contracts.reason: macOS lane runs identically when the selection does not narrow the lane away; reused only with hermes-compatibility-macos, whose absence means the source lane ran the Hermes tests itself

release-build.reason: release build of the same tree

sdk-macos.reason: SDK checks built from the same tree on macOS

shear.reason: unused-dependency check of the same tree

systemd-supervision.reason: builds the daemon, worker and CLI from the lockfile; nothing reads the selection

test.reason: formatting and lints of the same tree

ts-drift.reason: TypeScript binding drift of the same tree

udeps.reason: unused-dependency check of the same tree

names: upgrade from the previous release / upgrade from the previous release
upgrade-test.reason: upgrade from the previous release on the same tree
